key.name: profiles
key.description: Saved profiles, each with an id, a name, a kind ("stremio" or "guest") and the account email. Session keys are kept in the system keyring.

key.name: last-profile
key.description: The id of the profile that was used last.

key.name: donate-reminder-at
key.description: When the donation dialog was last shown, in seconds since 1970. It is shown again after 30 days.

key.name: welcome-shown
key.description: Whether the first-run setup and tour have been completed.

key.name: download-folder
key.description: Where downloads are saved, each in a folder named after its movie or series. Empty means the Downloads folder.

key.name: ask-download-location
key.description: Ask for a location every time something is downloaded.

key.name: hardware-decoding
key.description: Let mpv decode video on the GPU when it is safe to do so.

key.name: prefer-discrete-gpu
key.description: Start Chelsea on the NVIDIA graphics card when one is available. Takes effect after a restart.

key.name: audio-language
key.description: A comma separated list of language codes passed to mpv as alang, for example "eng,jpn".

key.name: subtitle-language
key.description: A comma separated list of language codes passed to mpv as slang, for example "eng".

key.name: volume
key.description: The last volume used in the player.

key.name: show-remaining
key.description: Show the time left instead of the time played in the player.

key.name: torrent-profile
key.description: How aggressively the Nuvio engine connects to peers.

key.name: torrent-cache-size
key.description: How many gigabytes of torrent data the engine keeps on disk.

key.name: torrent-upload
key.description: Upload torrent data to other peers during playback.
